notes.title: Sorry for the delay, but we think you will like what we got!
notes.content:
This is a major update!
Tested it on multiple headsets and systems.
Improved the look of the girl significantly
You can use your voice to give instructions with a significantly increased vocabulary size
The pointer only shows up when you point to a button so it is not in your hand all the time 
We have fixed multiple bugs with the code, the looks and the feel.
You don’t have to teleport around any longer. You can move around with the Joystick
Have fun!
